question: According to Hebrews 11:21, what did Jacob do when he was dying?
options: He blessed each of Joseph's sons and worshiped as he leaned on the top of his staff
He built an altar at Bethel
explanation: Hebrews 11:21 says by faith Jacob, when he was dying, blessed each of Joseph's sons, and worshiped as he leaned on the top of his staff.
